correctness.rationale: Case distinction by number t of label-two cells proves lower bound min(mn,m+n,n+2,m+2,6) on K_m square K_n. Equality for t=0,1,2 forces all-one, defender cross, same-row/column, or opposite-defender patterns; at t=3 weight six and total positive support excludes triangles for m,n>=4, leaving 2x2 L. These six feasible disjoint families yield all minima, including tied exceptional widths and exact labeled counts. Read RESULT.md and verify.py at immutable commit; direct checker enumerates small-weight labelings on 13 boards (reported replay not treated as infinite proof).
